displayName: Work Master (how a job is done)
description: ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 6 (work definition model) WorkMaster: the template of how one kind of job is done at Level 3 — the segment it executes and the equipment class, material, tool and personnel class it needs. A job order names it (FOR_WORK_MASTER).

properties.name: work_master_id
properties.description: Identity of the work master: its own number from the source system (MES).

properties.name: version
properties.description: Version of the work master as the source names it.

properties.name: work_type
properties.description: ISA-95 WorkType: Production, Maintenance, Quality or Inventory.

properties.name: duration_sec
properties.description: Expected duration of a job run by this work master.

properties.name: process_segment_ref
properties.description: The process segment this work master executes (FOR_PROCESS_SEGMENT).

properties.name: operations_segment_ref
properties.description: The operations segment (routing step) this work master executes (FOR_OPERATIONS_SEGMENT).

properties.name: operations_definition_ref
properties.description: The operations definition (routing) this work master belongs to (FOR_OPERATIONS_DEFINITION).

properties.name: equipment_class_ref
properties.description: The equipment class a job of this work master needs (SPECIFIES_EQUIPMENT).

properties.name: material_ref
properties.description: The article (material definition) this work master specifies (SPECIFIES_MATERIAL).

properties.name: tool_ref
properties.description: The tool (physical asset) this work master specifies (SPECIFIES_PHYSICAL_ASSET).

properties.name: personnel_class_ref
properties.description: The personnel class a job of this work master needs (SPECIFIES_PERSONNEL).

properties.name: parent_work_master_ref
properties.description: The work master this one is a part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 WorkMaster MADE_UP_OF WorkMaster).

relationships.description: The process segment this work master executes (B2MML WorkMaster.ProcessSegmentID).
The operations segment this work master executes (B2MML WorkMaster.OperationsSegmentID).
The operations definition this work master belongs to (B2MML WorkMaster.OperationsDefinitionID).
The equipment class a job needs (B2MML EquipmentSpecification.EquipmentClassID).
The material definition a job needs or makes (B2MML MaterialSpecification.MaterialDefinitionID).
The personnel class a job needs (B2MML PersonnelSpecification.PersonnelClassID).
The parent work master (ISA-95: WorkMaster MADE_UP_OF WorkMaster).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 6 WorkMaster = the Level-3 template of a job; JobOrder (cl. 7) and JobResponse (cl. 8) name it.
isa95.mappingNote: B2MML carries the parent through the nesting of the child in its parent, not as a field.
